integration_issues.issue: After a hard reload the activeProjectId is not persisted, so the studio defaults back to Quick Pad and mode-context-input renders empty even though the preamble was saved server-side (visible in the sidebar project-preamble-input once the project is re-selected). The spec item (b) 'refresh the page; the Context field is pre-filled with what was saved' therefore only works if the previously-active project is re-selected first. Persist activeProjectId in localStorage (or restore from URL) so context prefill survives reloads.

action_items: Persist active project selection across reloads (localStorage/URL) so ModeWorkspace ctx prefill works after refresh as spec requires.

rca of the issue: activeProjectId is only kept in React state (StudioProvider) with no persistence. On hard reload the studio initialises with null activeProjectId (Quick Pad). ModeWorkspace initialises the context field from `activeProject?.preamble`, which is undefined when no project is active. Result: the *server* saved the preamble correctly (verified via sidebar project-preamble-input on re-selection), but the *client* fails the 'refresh and see prefilled context' spec bullet until the project is re-opened. Fix: persist activeProjectId in localStorage on setActiveProjectId and hydrate it in the StudioProvider initializer.
